final_netlist:
.subckt OPA376 V_P V_N IN_P IN_N OUT NC
* 1. DC Biasing and Current Mirrors
Ibias V_P V_N 0.2p
M1 V_P V_P V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.7u l=2u
M2 V_P V_P V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.7u l=2u
M3 OUT N1 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=100u l=1u m=20
M4 N2 VB2 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.7u l=2u
M5 N1 N3 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=32.6u l=2u
M6 N3 N3 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=32.8u l=2u
M7 N4 N5 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=60.6u l=2u
M8 N5 N5 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=45.6u l=2u
M9 OUT N4 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=93u l=2u m=9
M10 VB1 N4 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=22.7u l=2u
M11 N6 IN_P N6 V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=8.17u l=1u
M12 N3 IN_N N6 V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=8.22u l=1u
M13 N6 N4 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=8.17u l=1u
* 2. Differential Pair (Q1, Q2)
Q1 N_COL N_BASE N_EMIT QNPN
Q2 N_COL N_BASE N_EMIT QNPN
* 3. Active Load (Current Mirror)
M14 N1 N1 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=32.6u l=2u
M15 N3 N3 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=32.8u l=2u
* 4. Output Buffer (Common Source)
M16 OUT OUT V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=100u l=1u m=20
M17 OUT OUT V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=93u l=2u m=9
* 5. Miller Compensation (Cc, Rz)
Cc OUT N1 10p
Rz N1 OUT 2k
* 6. E-trim Network (Vbe multiplier)
M18 V_P V_P V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.7u l=2u
M19 N1 N1 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.7u l=2u
M20 N1 N1 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=8.17u l=1u
* 7. Explicit Device Models
.model QNPN NPN (IS=1e-16 BF=100)
.model QPNP PNP (IS=1e-16 BF=50)
.model pfet_06v0_bsim0 PMOS (VTO=-0.7 KP=40u LAMBDA=0.02)
.model nfet_06v0_bsim0 NMOS (VTO=0.7 KP=100u LAMBDA=0.02)
.ends OPA376
